Script.name: gauges
Script.script: --[[ Gauges — the bars, in a window you can move Sean Stoves, 2026-08-02 Six of them, in the stock module's own arrangement: three columns of two. enemy moves tnl health mana align Colours are theirs, out of their config script rather than eyeballed - #1aa41a health, #4570fc mana, #b0b051 moves, #a343cd tnl, and align in three bands because alignment is a range and not a quantity: #d98839 good, #888 neutral, #8c2929 evil. Read straight off GMCP. char.vitals for the three that move constantly, char.maxstats for what they're out of, char.status for tnl, align and whatever is hitting you. Theirs are nailed into the bottom of the frame. These are a panel like every other one here: drag it, resize it, dock it, and it stays where you left it. The one thing not carried across is the potion count their bars show in brackets - '(0)'. That comes from three trigger-driven counters we don't have, and a bracket that always says zero is worse than no bracket. ]] aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.gauges = aardkit.gauges or {} local GA = aardkit.gauges local U = aardkit.util.named("Gauges") local G = aardkit.gmcp local CFG = U.load("gauges", { on = true, -- which of the six to draw, in case somebody wants four show = { enemy = true, moves = true, tnl = true, health = true, mana = true, align = true }, -- ON. Installing this takes the bars over: the stock module's Footer comes -- out of the bottom of its frame, because two sets of gauges is worse than -- either and theirs cannot be moved. -- -- A switch, not a one-way door - 'gauges standalone off' puts theirs back. -- Their scripts are left running: onVitals and onStatus feed the group -- panel and much of aard.* besides these bars, and switching them off to -- hide six widgets would take a good deal else with them. standalone = true, }) CFG.show = CFG.show or {} local function save() U.save("gauges", CFG) end --- -- their colours --- local COL = { health = { "#1aa41a", "#005500" }, mana = { "#4570fc", "#1133cc" }, moves = { "#b0b051", "#555511" }, tnl = { "#a343cd", "#4c006e" }, enemy = { "#f04141", "#cc0000" }, good = { "#d98839", "#814100" }, neutral = { "#888888", "#444444" }, evil = { "#8c2929", "#410000" }, } local BACK = "#101418" -- their layout: three columns, two rows, top row then bottom local GRID = { { "enemy", "moves", "tnl" }, { "health", "mana", "align" }, } -- Declared above everything that reads them. A table read by a function defined -- earlier binds a nil global, silently, and this project has paid for that nine -- times - most recently three commands ago. local bars = {} local function front(c1, c2) return "background-color: QLinearGradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:0, y2:1," .. " stop:0 " .. c1 .. ", stop:1 " .. c2 .. ");" end --- -- the panel --- local panel = aardkit.panel.new({ name = "gauges", title = "Gauges", x = "10px", y = "760px", width = 640, height = 56, consoleless = true, onbuild = function() bars = {} if aardkit.gauges and aardkit.gauges.paint then aardkit.gauges.paint() end end, onresize = function() if aardkit.gauges and aardkit.gauges.paint then aardkit.gauges.paint() end end, }) GA.panel = panel function GA.layout() if not panel.container then return end local w = U.px(panel.container.get_width and panel.container:get_width() or panel.container.width) local h = U.px(panel.container.get_height and panel.container:get_height() or panel.container.height) if w < 40 or h < 20 then return end -- only the ones switched on take up room, so hiding two makes the rest wider local cols = {} for c = 1, 3 do for r = 1, 2 do if CFG.show[GRID[r][c]] ~= false then cols[c] = true end end end local live = {} for c = 1, 3 do if cols[c] then live[#live + 1] = c end end if #live == 0 then return end local cw = math.floor(w / #live) local rh = math.floor(h / 2) for i, c in ipairs(live) do for r = 1, 2 do local b = bars[GRID[r][c]] if b then if CFG.show[GRID[r][c]] == false then pcall(function() b:hide() end) else pcall(function() b:show() end) pcall(function() b:move(cw * (i - 1), rh * (r - 1)) end) pcall(function() b:resize(cw - 2, rh - 2) end) end end end end end function GA.paint() if not panel.container then return end local gen = panel.gen or 1 for r = 1, 2 do for c = 1, 3 do local key = GRID[r][c] if not bars[key] then local ok, b = pcall(function() return Geyser.Gauge:new({ name = "aardkit_gauge_" .. key .. "_" .. gen, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10, }, panel.container) end) if ok and b then bars[key] = b pcall(function() b.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: " .. BACK .. ";") end) local col = COL[key] or COL.neutral pcall(function() b.front:setStyleSheet(front(col[1], col[2])) end) end end end end GA.layout() GA.update() end --- -- what goes in them --- local function pct(cur, max) cur, max = tonumber(cur) or 0, tonumber(max) or 0 if max <= 0 then return 0 end return math.floor(cur / max * 100) end local function set(key, cur, max, text) local b = bars[key] if not b or CFG.show[key] == false then return end pcall(function() b:setValue(math.max(0, tonumber(cur) or 0), math.max(1, tonumber(max) or 1), " " .. text .. "") end) end function GA.update() if not CFG.on then return end local hp, mhp = G.num("char.vitals.hp"), G.num("char.maxstats.maxhp") local mp, mmp = G.num("char.vitals.mana"), G.num("char.maxstats.maxmana") local mv, mmv = G.num("char.vitals.moves"), G.num("char.maxstats.maxmoves") if hp and mhp then set("health", hp, mhp, hp .. "hp | " .. pct(hp, mhp) .. "%") end if mp and mmp then set("mana", mp, mmp, mp .. "mp | " .. pct(mp, mmp) .. "%") end if mv and mmv then set("moves", mv, mmv, mv .. "mv | " .. pct(mv, mmv) .. "%") end -- TNL fills as you approach the level, so it's what you've EARNED of it - -- theirs does the same, which is why it reads (max - tnl) and not tnl. local tnl, mtnl = G.num("char.status.tnl"), G.num("char.status.tnlmax") if tnl then if mtnl and mtnl > 0 then set("tnl", mtnl - tnl, mtnl, "TNL: " .. tnl) else set("tnl", 1, 1, "TNL: " .. tnl) end end -- Alignment is a range from -1000 to 1000, not a quantity, so the bar shows -- how far from neutral you are and the COLOUR says which way. local al = G.num("char.status.align") if al then local band = (al >= 350 and "good") or (al <= -350 and "evil") or "neutral" local b = bars.align if b then local col = COL[band] pcall(function() b.front:setStyleSheet(front(col[1], col[2])) end) end set("align", math.abs(al), 1000, "Align: " .. al) end -- Whatever is hitting you, and how much of it is left. local ep = G.num("char.status.enemypct") local name = G.val("char.status.enemy") if name == "" or name == "none" then name = nil end set("enemy", ep or 0, 100, name and (U.strip_flags(name) .. " | " .. math.floor(ep or 0) .. "%") or "no enemy") end --- -- standing theirs down -- -- Their bars live in an HBox called Footer, put into the frame by guiLoad as -- addWindow(Footer, 'Gauges', 'bottom'). Removing it from the frame hides it; -- the object stays alive because it isn't ours to destroy, and a reinstall of -- theirs just gets removed again next load. --- function GA.unframe_theirs() if not (GUIframe and GUIframe.removeWindow and GUIframe.initialized) then return false end local ok = pcall(GUIframe.removeWindow, "Gauges", "bottom") local w = _G.Footer if type(w) == "table" and w.hide then pcall(function() w:hide() end) end return ok or type(w) == "table" end function GA.reframe_theirs() if not (GUIframe and GUIframe.addWindow and GUIframe.initialized) then return false end local w = _G.Footer if type(w) ~= "table" then return false end pcall(function() w:show() end) return (pcall(GUIframe.addWindow, w, "Gauges", "bottom")) end local unframed = false local function stand_down() if not CFG.standalone or not aard then return end if unframed then return end if GA.unframe_theirs() then unframed = true U.note("Stock gauges taken out of the frame - 'gauges standalone off' puts them back.") end end --- -- commands --- function GA.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg) rest = U.trim(rest) if aardkit.panel.verb("gauges", verb, rest) then return end if verb == "" or verb == "help" then local which = {} for _, row in ipairs(GRID) do for _, k in ipairs(row) do which[#which + 1] = k .. (CFG.show[k] == false and " (off)" or "") end end U.help("Gauges", { { "state", CFG.on and "on" or "off" }, { "bars", table.concat(which, " ") }, { "" }, { "gauges on|off", "stop updating them" }, { "gauges on|off", "hide one - enemy, moves, tnl, health, mana, align" }, { "gauges show|hide|dock|embed", "where the window lives" }, { "gauges standalone on|off", "stop the stock module's own bars" }, { "gauges opacity <0-255>", "how solid this window is; 'default' follows the shared setting" }, { "" }, { "Colours are the stock module's own, and the layout is its" }, { "three-by-two. The bracketed potion count is not carried across:" }, { "it needs counters we don't have, and a bracket that always" }, { "reads zero is worse than no bracket." }, }) elseif verb == "on" or verb == "off" then CFG.on = (verb == "on"); save() U.ok("Gauges " .. verb .. ".") if CFG.on then GA.update() end elseif verb == "standalone" then local v = rest:lower() if v ~= "on" and v ~= "off" then U.help("Standalone gauges", { { "state", CFG.standalone and "on - ours has the bars" or "off - theirs is in the frame too" }, { "installed", aard and "the stock module is here" or "none, nothing to do" }, { "" }, { "Footer (their HBox)", "the six bars along the bottom of their frame" }, { "", "-> this panel, which you can move" }, { "" }, { "Their onVitals and onStatus keep running: they feed the group" }, { "panel and much of aard.* besides these bars, so switching them" }, { "off to hide six widgets would take a good deal else with them." }, { "" }, { "gauges standalone on|off", "switch it" }, }) return end CFG.standalone = (v == "on"); save() if not aard then U.note("The stock module isn't installed - ours already has the bars."); return end if v == "on" then unframed = false stand_down() U.ok("Stock gauges out of the frame - ours has the bars.") else GA.reframe_theirs() unframed = false U.ok("Stock gauges back in their frame.") end elseif verb == "show" or verb == "hide" or verb == "dock" or verb == "embed" then aardkit.panel.cmd("gauges " .. verb) if verb ~= "hide" then GA.paint() end elseif COL[verb] or verb == "align" or verb == "enemy" then local want = rest:lower() CFG.show[verb] = (want ~= "off") save(); GA.layout(); GA.update() U.ok(verb .. " gauge " .. (CFG.show[verb] and "on" or "off") .. ".") else U.warn("gauges on|off | on|off | show|hide|dock|embed ('gauges help')") end end aardkit.register("gauges", "the bars, in a window you can move", GA.cmd) -- vitals move constantly; status carries tnl, align and the enemy aardkit.gmcp.need("gauges", "Char 1") aardkit.gmcp.watch("gauges", { "char.vitals", "char.status", "char.maxstats" }, "aardkit.gauges.update", true) GA.paint() -- guiLoad builds their footer on connect rather than at script load, so the -- load-time attempts pass before it exists. Same lesson as the chat tabs. for _, t in ipairs({ 1, 4, 9, 16, 25 }) do tempTimer(t, stand_down) end U.killhandler(aardkit_gauges_connect) aardkit_gauges_connect = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", function() for _, t in ipairs({ 2, 6, 12, 20 }) do tempTimer(t, stand_down) end end)
